name: William Marks
life: “I still remember dating a family letter by the grain of its film.” Friday often includes a stop at Maré Coffee, where William likes the table where people coming off shift stop checking the time.
voice: I needed a date for my parents' first meeting. Their old picture shows the hook resting right on the gull.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a charcoal zip cardigan and a cloth patch so neatly matched it only shows in strong light. William has a crooked front tooth visible when laughing, with thick, tightly coiled hair. William presses the lips together to keep a smile in during a conversation.
personality: William takes a rejection personally for a day and analytically on the second morning. William can be generous with a rival once the first night's sleep has intervened.
agenda: To date the parents' harbor photograph.
family: Malcolm Fields is William’s nephew by marriage. William asks before bringing somebody along. Malcolm can always ask for five minutes alone. It keeps a conversation between two people from unexpectedly turning into a family committee. Asked about *Two birthdays in one ward*, Malcolm says, “I want the biggest stupid balloon in the hospital.”
connections: Edmund Porter. A father's dated picture gives a retired crane operator the time of the gull's next meeting.
